accent: No accent key. 16 velocity- and pressure-sensitive pads; FULL LEVEL key forces maximum level; 16 LEVELS spreads one sound over all 16 pads at 16 steps of velocity, tune, attack or decay; per-note velocity modulation of volume (0-100%), attack and soft start.
global_features: No built-in effects and no filter; echo send output + echo return input for an external unit
Swing 50-75% on 1/8 or 1/16 notes (66% = triplet swing; manual suggests 54% and 62%)
Timing correct (quantize) and Note Repeat
16 voices; sounds stored 12-bit non-linear at 40 kHz; 13.1 s mono memory (26.2 s expanded)
128 sounds (34 before v3), 8 programs x 64 note assignments on MIDI notes 35-98
4 pad banks A-D in v3 (2 banks / 32 fixed pad names in v1-v2)
Up to 3 sounds per note: simultaneous, velocity switch (VEL SW) or decay switch (DCY SW)
Cutoff: any note can silence up to 2 other notes (manual example: closed hat stops open hat); Mono mode restarts a voice
Outputs: stereo mix, 8 individual outs (or pairs 1-2/3-4/5-6/7-8), echo send; headphones on MPC60 II
Sequencer: 99 sequences x 99 tracks, 20 songs, 60,000 notes, 96 ppq; MIDI out 4 ports
v3 sample edit can reverse any portion of a sound
Factory disks: Studio set, Rock set, Dry set, Synth set; add-on library SL601-SL630

accent: No accent control. Responds to MIDI velocity 1-127; velocity (or key position) can modulate pitch, level and decay per sound. Manual example: velocity on decay makes a hard hit an open hat and a soft hit a closed hat.
global_features: No built-in effects; 8 mono individual outs + mono mix out, no pan
8-voice polyphony; free-assign mode gives a new note the quietest channel; fixed-assign mode routes each sound to out 1-8, and two sounds on one out cut each other
32 programs x 16 sounds; each sound has a key range of up to 16 keys; up to 8 sounds can layer on one key
2 ROM card slots (EXT1 front, EXT2 rear); SL801R and SL802R supplied, SL803R and SL804R optional
16-bit samples, 1 MB internal ROM; 33/44 kHz per MT review (polynominal says 32 or 44 kHz)
Reverse playback per sound (REPLAY F/b); pitch sweep with up/down polarity
MT review: random pitch and duration fluctuation available
MIDI in/out/thru; Omni at shipment; program change 1-32; SysEx program dumps; MIDI monitor; memory protect on at shipment
No sequencer; SHOT key auditions the selected sound

accent: ACCENT key: hold it while hitting a pad for a louder hit; accents are recorded per note. Pads are not velocity-sensitive. Step write lets you edit velocity; MIDI note-on velocity 1-127 is recognized. MT review: in step time the 15 pads play the selected sound at 15 different velocities. Velocity Feel softens the attack at low velocity.
global_features: No built-in effects; per-sound Effect Send (0-31) + master send knob feed an EFFECT SEND output for an external unit
8-voice polyphony; MT review: a 9th note on one beat erases the earliest note on that beat
10 pad banks of 15 pads: banks 1-5 fixed, 6-10 user-assignable
65 preset sounds + 32 user sounds (66-97) = edited copies of presets
450 preset patterns: 50 styles x (3 variations of 2 bars, 3 fill-ins, intro, break, ending)
99 user patterns, 20 songs (up to 99 parts), 96 ppq (1/384 note), tempo 40-296 BPM
Timing correct, note repeat, sound replace, auto scan
Outputs: stereo L/R (mono from L), effect send, headphones; no individual outs
MIDI in/out (no thru) with separate receive and transmit note maps; metronome sends note 24
Footswitch jacks: start/stop and fill-in
No swing/shuffle parameter found in the manual contents or reviews

pack_contents: Two folders. 'Akai XR-10': 57 stereo 16-bit/44.1 kHz WAVs in subfolders Bassdrums (Bassdrum-01..10), Snaredrums (Snaredrum-01..10), Cymbals (Crash-01..03, Hat Closed, Hat Middle, Hat Open, Ride), Percussion (Agogo, Cabasa, Clap, Claves, Conga-01..04, Cowbell, Fingersanp [sic], Guiro-01, Guirro-02 [sic], Rim Shot-01/02, Tambourine, Timbale H/L, Tom L-01/02, Tom M-01/02, Toma H-01 [sic], Tom H-02, Triangle, Vibrator [= vibraslap], Whistle), Misc (Hit, Slap Bass, Square Kick-01/02). Only 6 of 12 toms, 1 agogo, 1 triangle; Crash-03 (0.45 s) is probably CHOKE and 'Square Kick-01/02' probably SQUEAK L/H (both inferred). 'Akai XR10': 62 mono WAVs, flat: XR10Kick01-10, XR10Snare01-10, XR10Rimshot01-02, XR10Hat_C/_Mid/_O, XR10LoTom01-04, XR10MidTom01-04, XR10HiTom01-04 (toms grouped by pitch, not by set), XR10Crash01-02, XR10RideCymbal, XR10Choke, XR10Clap, XRFinSnap, XRConga01-04, XR10Vibra, XRGuira01-02, XRCabasa, XR10Tamborine, XRTambroll (not in the ROM list), XR10Triangle, XRCow, XRClave, XR10Whistle, XR10HiQ01-02 (probably SQUEAK L/H), XR10Timb_Hi/_Lo, XRAgogo. Missing there: HITS, CHOP, one triangle, one agogo. Names, not ROM numbers; no loops.

accent: ACCENT key: hold it while playing an instrument key to accent that note. Accent adds 80 of 255 final volume units on top of PER INSTRUMENT VOLUME (0-175, in 16 steps of 11). Accent on/off is stored per note. MIDI velocity is divided into 16 volume levels and can also accent MIDI notes.
global_features: No built-in effects; internal mono mixer with no pan
6 channel outputs (one per channel) + metronome out + mono AUDIO OUT; only one instrument per channel sounds at a time
Swing 50/54/58/62/66/70% on eighth notes, only when the beat value is a quarter note; default 50%; set per pattern while stopped
Any time signature: 1-99 beats per measure; beat values 1/2 to 1/32 incl. triplets
99 patterns up to 100 measures; 99 songs of up to 100 steps; 3,289 notes; tempo 40-250 BPM
Songs can program relative volume and tempo changes
MIDI in/out: note on per instrument with velocity; Omni at power-up; song select, clock, start/stop/continue, SysEx dump
Clock in 24/48/96 ppqn; clock out 24/48 ppqn; cassette save/load; RUN/STOP and NEXT/REPEAT footswitches
Sound ROMs swappable; accepts LinnDrum ROM chips (Wikipedia)
No flam, roll or reverse function documented

accent: No accent key documented. Dynamics come from 8 programmable volume levels per note and from MIDI velocity on a touch-sensitive keyboard; Human Factor randomly varies level and pitch; error-correct rolls can get louder or quieter.
global_features: No built-in effects; stereo L/R outs (L doubles as headphones), no individual outs
4 playback channels shared by all sounds; a retriggered sound restarts unless Stack mode lets it overlap (up to 4)
Reverse button plays sounds backwards (described as the first drum machine reverse)
32-step tuning, 8 volume levels and pan, all programmable per note
Improv: random fills at a set percentage; Human Factor: small random pitch/level changes
Auto repeat for rolls; error correct (quantize) from 2 up to 96
Tempo 40-240 BPM
About 100 patterns and up to 100 songs (reviews differ); 2,300 notes, expandable to about 10,400
Cartridge port for ROM packs of 7-8 extra sounds (Latin Percussion first; E&MM also lists Standard Drumkit, Electronic and Effects packs)
MIDI in/out: bottom keys pick the sound, upper keys play its 32 pitches; velocity sets level; sends clock and start/stop/continue
Clock out, tape sync, trigger out, programmable footswitch
No swing/shuffle or flam documented in the four reviews
